overview: SAMPLE DATA so you can see the page before the agent's first run. Delete this file and its index.json entry once the real brief publishes.

items.title: Example: game engine flaw lets malicious files run code
items.summary: A sample item showing how a vulnerability in a tool on your watchlist appears at the top of the brief.
items.action: Update the editor and rebuild any shipped games with the patched version.
items.helpDesk: Users who build or run games may need help updating installed software safely.

items.title: Example: actively exploited VPN vulnerability
items.summary: A sample item showing how a CISA 'known exploited' entry is labeled.
items.action: Apply the vendor patch or disconnect the device until patched.
items.helpDesk: Remote workers may lose VPN access during emergency patching; expect tickets.

items.title: Example: phishing campaign impersonates package delivery
items.action: Remind users to check delivery status on the carrier's site, not via email links.
items.helpDesk: Expect password reset requests from users who clicked; know your reset process.
